description: Implement the hardened FFmpeg EC2 worker: idempotent SQS consume->process->delete-only-on-success loop, control-message guard, video_id parsed from the key prefix, the mandated 720p/H.264-baseline-3.1/AAC downscale, two-shape Failed handling, and graceful SIGTERM drain via the ASG lifecycle hook. Independent of FEAT-003/004 (shares only the DynamoDB/S3/SQS contracts from DESIGN). Grounded in DESIGN.md sections: SQS + DLQ (Failed writers 1 and 2), Worker ASG graceful drain, video_id derivation + Control-message guard, FFmpeg sourcing + downscale, Testability (worker unit list). Also projects/video-streaming-app.md worker flags.
steps: Implement worker/worker.py: boto3 long-poll loop (receive_message WaitTimeSeconds=20) reading QUEUE_URL/INPUT_BUCKET/OUTPUT_BUCKET/TABLE_NAME/ASG_NAME from env. Control-message guard: for each body, if it is not valid JSON, has Event==s3:TestEvent, or lacks Records[0].s3.object.key matching ^input/(?P<video_id>[0-9a-f]{32})/ -> log at info and delete_message WITHOUT processing. Parse video_id from the key PREFIX only (never the filename).

Processing path: get_item for video_id and SKIP (delete message) if status already Ready (idempotency). Else download the raw object, run the exact argv: ffmpeg -i <in> -vf scale=-2:720 -c:v libx264 -profile:v baseline -level 3.1 -c:a aac -f hls -hls_time 6 -hls_playlist_type vod <out_dir>/playlist.m3u8. Upload the playlist + .ts segments to output/<video_id>/, update_item status Processing then Ready (update_item, never put_item), then delete_message.

Failure handling (two shapes): a non-zero FFmpeg subprocess exit = deterministic rejection -> update_item status=Failed, delete_message, no retry. A transient error from any boto3/OS operation (download get_object, local disk ENOSPC, DynamoDB ClientError) -> log and RE-RAISE / do not delete, so the message is redelivered and only dead-letters after max_receive_count=3. Distinguish strictly by which operation raised.

Graceful drain: install a SIGTERM handler that finishes or cleanly aborts the in-flight transcode then calls autoscaling CompleteLifecycleAction; while transcoding, periodically call RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat so the ASG termination lifecycle hook (added in FEAT-005) does not time out.

Add worker/user-data.sh: download ffmpeg+ffprobe from s3://video-artifacts-678602035067-us-east-1/ffmpeg/ to /usr/local/bin via the gateway endpoint, create the appuser, write a systemd EnvironmentFile (/etc/video-worker.env) from the instance's CDK-injected env values, and enable worker/video-worker.service. Add worker/video-worker.service (User=appuser, ExecStart python worker.py, Restart, logs routed to CloudWatch group /video/worker). Add worker/requirements.txt (boto3).

Add worker/tests/test_worker.py (pytest, subprocess mocked, boto3 via botocore.stub.Stubber): video_id extraction from an S3-event key; idempotency skip when already Ready; FFmpeg argv assembly asserts scale=-2:720 + baseline + level 3.1 + aac; Failed-on-nonzero-exit path (worker-survives case) writes Failed and deletes; control-message/s3:TestEvent body is dropped without processing; a simulated get_object ClientError is re-raised / message left for redelivery.
acceptance_criteria: pytest worker/tests passes, covering: key->video_id, idempotency skip, argv assembly, Failed-on-nonzero-exit, control-message drop, transient-error-redelivery.
ruff check . passes and python -m compileall worker.py reports no syntax/import errors.
worker.py contains no bare `except:`; transient vs deterministic failures take different branches.
verification: cd projects/video-streaming-app/worker && pip install -r requirements.txt pytest ruff
findings:
DONE & verified (ruff clean, 13 pytest pass, compileall clean) in projects/video-streaming-app/worker/.

ENV VAR CONTRACT the worker reads (FEAT-005 must inject these exact names into the worker launch-template EnvironmentFile /etc/video-worker.env; user-data.sh already writes them from @@...@@ placeholders): required QUEUE_URL, INPUT_BUCKET, OUTPUT_BUCKET, TABLE_NAME; optional-but-needed-for-drain ASG_NAME, LIFECYCLE_HOOK_NAME; optional AWS_REGION (default us-east-1), FFMPEG_BIN (default /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg), INSTANCE_ID (worker falls back to IMDSv2 lookup if unset). I introduced LIFECYCLE_HOOK_NAME (not named in the FEAT text) because autoscaling CompleteLifecycleAction/RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat require a hook name alongside ASG_NAME + InstanceId -- FEAT-005 must name its autoscaling.LifecycleHook (EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING, heartbeat 900s, default CONTINUE) and pass that name in as LIFECYCLE_HOOK_NAME. Graceful drain degrades to a no-op (worker still exits on SIGTERM) when ASG_NAME/LIFECYCLE_HOOK_NAME/INSTANCE_ID are absent, so local runs need none of them.

ARTIFACT/ASSET PATHS: user-data.sh pulls ffmpeg+ffprobe from s3://<ARTIFACT_BUCKET>/ffmpeg/ffmpeg and .../ffprobe to /usr/local/bin (matches DataStack BucketDeployment destination_key_prefix='ffmpeg/' over Source.asset('assets/ffmpeg/bin')); FEAT-005 should substitute @@ARTIFACT_BUCKET@@=video-artifacts-678602035067-us-east-1 and @@AWS_REGION@@=us-east-1, plus copy worker.py -> /tmp/worker.py and video-worker.service -> /tmp/ before user-data runs (or inline them). systemd unit: User=appuser, WorkingDirectory=/opt/video-worker, TimeoutStopSec=900 (= hook heartbeat), KillSignal=SIGTERM, logs via journald to CloudWatch group /video/worker (CloudWatch agent config is FEAT-005's to add).

DESIGN DECISIONS: worker writes Failed + deletes on non-zero ffmpeg exit (deterministic); re-raises any boto3/OS error (get_object, put_object, update_item, disk) so SQS redelivers -> dead-letters at maxReceiveCount=3 (DLQ-marker Lambda = FEAT-004 owns that Failed write). DynamoDB uses low-level client with update_item only (never put_item); PK attribute name is 'video_id' (String), status attr is 'status' aliased via #s (reserved word). S3 transfer uses get_object/put_object (not managed download_file/upload_file) to stay botocore.Stubber-friendly. HLS content types set on upload: .m3u8 -> application/vnd.apple.mpegurl, .ts -> video/mp2t. video_id regex is ^input/(?P<video_id>[0-9a-f]{32})/ parsed from key PREFIX only; S3 event keys are URL-unquoted (unquote_plus) before matching. ffmpeg argv is exactly the DESIGN downscale (scale=-2:720, libx264/baseline/level 3.1, aac, hls, hls_time 6, playlist_type vod). The VPC-origin SG AWS-doc confirmation is FEAT-005's item, not touched here.

NOTE: the FEAT-005 agent should mirror these same env var names in the WEB-tier launch template per NIT_env_injection.
